name: Nigatsu Muika
source:
It's Yamazaki birthday. Main character gets so busy with the investigation at work and reporting to Hijikata that he does not have time to prepare a present.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
今天是山崎退的生日。主角忙于工作上的调查，还要向土方十四郎汇报，忙得连准备礼物的时间都没有。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
